source: Latency behavior can differ too. A hit at one cache level may be faster than a miss that travels farther, but the exact penalty depends on architecture and request type. Some specialized cache paths, such as texture fetches, have semantics that should not be generalized to ordinary global loads.[1][3]
zh: 延迟行为也可能有所不同。一个缓存级别的命中可能比传播更远的未命中更快，但确切的损失取决于体系结构和请求类型。一些专门的缓存路径（例如纹理获取）具有不应推广到普通全局加载的语义。[1][3]
